lead: Run a boutique or online store in Dubai, Abu Dhabi or Sharjah? Under the India–UAE CEPA, Indian-made kurtis and suits can be imported duty-free. Here is how duty, VAT and documents work.
seo_title: Import Kurtis from India to UAE Wholesale: 0% Duty (CEPA Guide 2026)
seo_description: UAE boutiques can import Indian kurtis at 0% duty under the India–UAE CEPA. 5% VAT, trade licence, certificate of origin, 5–10 day express shipping and MOQ 15–20 pieces.
body:
## Quick answer

Under the **India–UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)**, in force since **1 May 2022**, Indian-origin apparel can be imported at **0% duty** (standard GCC rate 5%) with a **CEPA certificate of origin**. **5% VAT** applies at import. Express shipping from India usually takes about **5–10 business days**.

## Duty and tax at a glance

| Item | Rule |
|---|---|
| Standard GCC duty | 5% |
| Duty under CEPA (Indian origin, with certificate) | **0%** |
| VAT at import | 5% |
| Typical express transit from India | About 5–10 business days |

## Documents you need

- **Commercial invoice** from the supplier
- **IEC** on the Indian side – we have this
- **CEPA certificate of origin**, to claim 0% duty
- Your **trade licence** and **customs code**

## Labelling

Labelling rules for retail goods, including Arabic labels, can apply. Confirm with your customs broker; we can stitch labels to your requirements.

## Tips for boutiques

- Eid, Diwali and the winter wedding season are peak times – order 6–8 weeks ahead
- Fast transit makes small, frequent reorders easy
- Ask for the CEPA certificate with every shipment

*This guide is general information for buyers, not legal or customs advice. Duty rates depend on the exact HS code and fabric, and rules change, so always confirm with your customs broker or courier before importing. Information checked November 2026.*
